meta.description: Golden vectors for WickChart's exported indicator kernels
meta.method: References: independent numpy/pandas implementations (tests/golden/generate.py), cross-checked against the third-party 'ta' package where conventions align (see docs/correctness.md); tiny10 cases are hand-derived on round numbers. Values are rounded to 12 significant digits; the CI test tolerance absorbs the rounding.

inputs.walk150: 150 synthetic bars over 3 midnight-crossing UTC sessions (deterministic LCG seed 42; sinusoidal drift + noise; one zero-volume bar; one repeated close)
inputs.macdline150: the MACD line of walk150 (leading nulls, for calcEMASparse)

cases.note: first bar is 0; flat close adds nothing
same EMA over a series with leading nulls
rolling population stdev of log returns; first output at index p
Wilder; seed = simple mean of first p changes, first output at p
EMA(fast)-EMA(slow); signal = sparse EMA seeded on the first 9 values
SMA mid +/- mult x population stdev
Wilder RMA over TR, seeded with the SMA of the first p TRs
hlc3 tp, cumulative, reset at each UTC-day boundary
slow stoch: raw %K, %K = SMA(smooth), %D = SMA(smooth) of %K
typical price vs SMA, 0.015 constant, mean deviation per window
ratcheting ATR bands; null gap on flips; stateful (convention-pinned)
midpoints; senkou displaced +disp (arrays run past the last bar); chikou displaced back
